'''Logron''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He had a [[Logron's desert farmstead|farmstead]] near [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]], a town on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. At some point, he took away the ''[[Blue Flare]]'', [[Sona Fey'lya]]'s [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], as payback. She was able to steal it later, with the help of the Pero brothers and an adventurer.
